facts.headline: The 2025 Total Lunar Eclipse: A 'Blood Moon' Illuminates the Night Sky
facts.summary: A total lunar eclipse on the night of March 13–14, 2025 will turn the Moon a deep red—a 'Blood Moon'—visible across the Americas with no equipment needed. Beyond the how-to, the eclipse is a quiet study in the difference between the systems we can predict and the ones we cannot.
